title: The Course of True Love (and First Dates)
author: Cassandra Clare
note: conf=0.94; Refuted the proposed series=None. This is an e-only short story that is part of The Bane Chronicles (11-story sequence later collected in the 2014 anthology), positioned as #10. Unlike several other Bane Chronicles stories co-written with Sarah Rees Brennan or Maureen Johnson, this one is credited to Cassandra Clare alone, so the author field is correct. Title as given matches the canonical title (also styled with brackets on Goodreads and subtitled "A Magnus Bane Story" in some print editions).
